requests.why: 미주신경성 실신 topic(순환_12) 도입부 행위 클립. 기존 act_strain_on_toilet은 힘주는 자세만 있어 변비·치질·과민성대장 어디에나 붙고 실신이 안 보인다. act_sink_to_floor는 선 자세에서의 붕괴라 화장실 맥락이 없다. 나레이션 훅이 '화장실에서 힘주다가 눈앞이 하얘지고 식은땀이 난 적 있으신가요?'라 두 요소(힘주기 → 무너짐)가 한 동작 안에 이어져야 한다.
requests.midjourney: translucent blue x-ray style human body seated on a toilet in a narrow bathroom, side-three-quarter view, elbows braced on thighs and torso folded forward, one hand pressed flat against the tile wall beside him, abdominal cavity and chest glowing amber from bearing down, heart and the vagus nerve running down the neck faintly outlined, dark teal background, vertical 9:16, no readable text, no facial features
requests.flow: One continuous shot in a single unbroken scene with no scene cuts, a medical holographic visualization of a single translucent glass-like human figure seated on a plain seat, every structure rendered in the same soft pale cyan glow, smooth featureless face, dark empty slate blue-grey void, the camera easing slowly forward. 0-1.5s: from the very first frame the figure leans forward over the thighs with the shoulders drawn up toward the ears and the breath held, and inside the torso the abdominal cavity lights hot amber as pressure builds, the glow pressing upward against the underside of the chest. 1.5-3s: the amber in the chest thins and fades as the returning flow drops, a single bright line runs down the side of the neck and pulses once, and the heart's rhythm visibly widens to two slow heavy beats. 3-4.5s: the glow inside the head dims from the top down until only a faint rim is left, the shoulders settle, the head lowers slowly toward the knees and one hand comes to rest flat on the thigh, the camera stopping with the head-to-hips region filling the frame. 4.5-6s: the figure stays still and low, the neck line and the emptied chest throbbing amber twice while the head stays dim, holding until the very last frame. The body stays translucent glass with all structures visible inside throughout; the face stays smooth and featureless, the dark slate blue-grey void stays empty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows anywhere in the frame. The audio is a low synth drone with two slow heartbeat thumps and a thin falling tone, no music, no dialogue.
requests._redo_why: Flow가 프롬프트를 거부했다(2026-09-24). 원인으로 본 것: ①he/his로 사람을 지칭하고 ②'neck gives out'·'feet skid'·'tips sideways'처럼 **쓰러지는 몸**을 직접 묘사했으며 ③캐논 서두(translucent glass figure·featureless face·no text)가 통째로 빠져 있었다. 의학 시각화라는 맥락을 먼저 세우고, 실신은 **뇌 점등이 꺼지는 것**으로 바꿔 표현한다.
